newsitem.title: UK: Prudential gains after sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Prudential gains after sales rise.

text.p: Shares in Prudential Corp rose on Monday after the composite insurer said single contribution sales were up 71 percent in the UK in 1996.
The shares gained 4-1/2p to 552-1/2p by 0913 GMT.
Prudential also said global single contribution sales rose by 69 percent in 1996 and regular contribution sales rose 13 percent to 516 million stg.
Analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing said the figures met with their forecasts. "They were in line with forecasts, perhaps at the top end of expectations."
Last week rival insurance company Legal & General reported its own sales figures for the year.
"Legal & General came up with 34 percent growth in adjusted new business figures compared with 38.7 percent for the Pru," one industry analyst said.

"But if you compare the two, Legal and General was more harshly hit by currency factors than the Prudential because of differences in calculation between the use of year end and average rates," the analyst said.
"On the whole we think Legal and General has stronger underlying growth but Prudential has better equivalent growth,"
Shares in Legal & General were down 1p at 396-1/2p by 0950 GMT.
